label: Men's ODI
methodology: Replay 100 completed first innings. At each checkpoint, predict final score from match state without future data. Fielding ratings from Cricsheet ball-by-ball data (5094 players, 110 teams).
summary: Across 400 predictions the model has an MAE of 41.3 runs and RMSE of 54.4 runs. Bias is -6.2 runs (the model undershoots on average). The predicted range captures the actual score 47.0% of the time with an average range width of 65 runs. Error by final score bucket: low-scoring (<160): 31.9 runs MAE, mid-range (160–200): 29.6 runs MAE, high-scoring (200+): 43.6 runs MAE. Predictions are least accurate at the 10-over checkpoint (MAE 58.0 runs) and most accurate at 40 overs (MAE 22.7 runs).
